purpose: Owner-level execution wiring metadata for the universal dispatcher. This file is not business task state and does not replace TASK_MANIFEST/HANDOFF.

evidence_contract: persisted sample receipt in authoritative WritingState
profile id and exact profile version
every profile hook explicitly assessed as INVOKED or NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_ACTION
Universal must independently verify that each evidence ref resolves to trusted evidence
Universal must separately verify that the trusted evidence semantically supports the hook assessment and reason
a real but irrelevant evidence ref cannot establish INVOKED or NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_ACTION
each claimed content mode has complete real-rejection evidence and at least two distinct held-out topic families
candidate distillation binds a real rejection and separates root cause from mechanism
at least two candidate mechanisms with failure-mode/counterexample evidence
bounded authority surfaces and superseded-mechanism disposition
each judge run binds exact candidate id and candidate-change ref
execution refs are independently verified and unique per pairwise run
an independent semantic verifier confirms the judge run evidence actually supports the run identity, candidate binding, blind setup and preference conclusion
held-out non-regression with at least one candidate win
real user acceptance/edit or performance evidence only when claiming PERSONALIZED_WRITING_DNA

owner_notes: The Python state machine remains business authority; LLM executors may not skip stages.
Repository wiring does not prove the current ChatGPT session has the optional SDK/runtime. The dispatcher must perform a session handshake.

Material explicit user writing feedback on a persisted task must be captured through the owner plugin learning-evidence capability before durable personalized-learning claims; current-turn revision may still proceed if capture is unavailable, but durable personalized learning must then be reported unavailable.
Owner-generated methodology receipts remain UNVERIFIED_OWNER_RECEIPT and cannot self-certify Universal operational methodology conformance.

The current general editorial quality corpus is NOT promotion-ready even for FINANCE_DEEP because only one complete held-out FINANCE_DEEP topic family exists. FINANCE_DEEP remains diagnostic/candidate-design evidence only until a second distinct held-out topic family is complete. FINANCE_BROAD is also not ready. Any future promotion additionally requires independent evidence-ref verification plus independent semantic verification of each judge run.
Normal independent audits are separate SDK runs when the SDK path is used, but the owner does not currently claim ATTESTED_ISOLATED assurance.
